pattern: (lip[- ]?read|lipread|visual speech recognition|\bVSR\b|\bAVSR\b|audio-visual speech recognition|audiovisual speech recognition)
inclusion_rule: Studies whose ledger text names lip reading, visual speech recognition (VSR), AVSR or audio-visual speech recognition, classified from the full text (reference list removed) by the training-label source for unlabelled video: transcripts produced by an audio ASR model or other automatic labeller (pseudo-labels), self-supervised pretraining, or cross-modal teacher distillation. Boundary: a study counts under every design its text names, mentions in related work included (upper bound); papers that only cite or reuse Auto-AVSR as a checkpoint or scorer stay in the population; video-to-speech synthesis is in the population only when its ledger names VSR or AVSR; versions counted once.
